name: Ranger Combat Style
description: At 2nd level, choose archery or two-weapon combat. The selected style grants additional feats at 6th and 11th level. These bonus feats are usable only while wearing light armor or no armor until combat style mastery.

options.name: Archery
options.description: Gain Rapid Shot at 2nd level, Manyshot at 6th level, and Improved Precise Shot at 11th level.

options.name: Two-Weapon Combat
options.description: Gain Two-Weapon Fighting at 2nd level, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting at 6th level, and Greater Two-Weapon Fighting at 11th level.
